Expert Consulting

Design review, planning, risk mitigation, and expert guidance for your container home or alternative housing project.

What We Offer

Design Review & Feasibility

$500–2,000

Send us your plans, photos, or ideas. We review for:

  • Structural feasibility
  • Code compliance risks
  • Cost optimization opportunities
  • Timeline risks
  • Supply chain and trade coordination

Deliverable: Written report with findings and recommendations (3–5 pages).

Full Planning Package

$3,000–10,000

End-to-end planning for your project:

  • Design optimization (if needed)
  • Detailed cost breakdown (materials, labor, contingency)
  • Timeline with milestones and dependencies
  • Risk register (what could go wrong, how to mitigate)
  • Permitting and code compliance roadmap
  • Vendor and trade coordination plan

Deliverable: 20–30 page planning document + 2 follow-up calls.

Fractional Architect / Project Manager

$150–250/hour

Ongoing support during your build:

  • Design decisions and problem-solving
  • Code compliance questions
  • Cost overrun analysis and mitigation
  • Timeline adjustments
  • Trade coordination and conflict resolution

Deliverable: Hourly or monthly retainer. You call when you need guidance.

Why Work With Us

Real Experience

We've designed and built a full container home. We know costs, timelines, mistakes, and trade-offs firsthand.

Risk Thinking

15+ years of enterprise risk and resilience expertise. We don't just answer questions—we identify risks others miss.

Vendor Network

We know contractors, material suppliers, permitting officials, and inspectors. We can help you avoid bad decisions.

Practical, Not Theoretical

Advice grounded in actual constraints: budgets, timelines, local codes, trade availability. No fluff.

How It Works

  1. Schedule a free 30-minute call. Tell us about your project, goals, and timeline.
  2. We propose a scope and price. Pick the service that fits.
  3. You get actionable advice. Written report, calls, or ongoing support depending on what you chose.
  4. You execute with clarity. You have a roadmap. We're available for follow-up questions.
